meta.reference: Bluey — identity discipline only, not animation fidelity
meta.note: This file is the single source of truth for colour and type. Figma components and image-generation prompts both derive from it. Change it here first, never downstream.

ink.use: Line-free shape darks, text, shadow base. Never pure black.

aegean.use: Anchor blue. Sea, sky, brand primary.

sun.use: Golden ochre. Light, wheat, lamplight, brand accent.

plum.use: RESERVED. Host character only, plus dusk skies. See host colour lock.

seafoam.use: Shallow water, secondary cool, highlight on blue.

storm.use: Cold northern weather, damp stone, overcast ground.

deepsea.use: Night water, deep sea, the dark end of the blue range.

rules.outlines: None. Shapes read by colour contrast only.
rules.gradients: One soft vertical sky gradient permitted per scene. Nothing else.
rules.texture: None. No grain, no paper tooth, no brush edge, no noise.
rules.shadows: Hard-edged, single direction, ink at 15% opacity, zero blur.
rules.rendering: No lighting simulation, no ambient occlusion, no specular, no depth of field.
rules.blackAndWhite: Never pure #000 or #FFF. Use ink and bone.
rules.plumLock: The host is the only plum object permitted in any frame she appears in.

midday-white.mood: Bleached Greek noon. High key, hard shadows, heat.
midday-white.use: Village squares, midday journeys, the Hare's overconfidence.

dusk-violet.mood: Evening settling. Warm windows against a cooling sky.
dusk-violet.use: Endings, going home, the frame story with the host.

olive-shade.mood: Under the trees. Dappled but flat, cool and calm.
olive-shade.use: Forests, groves, the Tortoise's steady middle stretch.

storm-grey.mood: Cold, damp, northern. One warm point of light only.
storm-grey.use: British tales, danger, weather, moments of fear.

hearth-amber.mood: Indoors, lamplit, safe. The storytelling colour.
hearth-amber.use: Host framing shots, kitchens, resolutions, the last beat.

sea-deep.mood: Night and deep water. Cool, quiet, vast.

display.use: Titles, title cards, thumbnails, the wordmark.
display.note: Chosen for rounded warmth plus verified Greek coverage. VERIFY Greek glyphs before locking any substitute.

subtitle.use: Burnt-in subtitles, lower thirds, end-card credits.
subtitle.note: Must render Greek polytonic-free modern orthography cleanly at 1080p and at Shorts crop.

planes.P0: Sky / void. Flat or single vertical gradient. Parallax 0.0
planes.P1: Far landscape. Silhouetted mass, no detail. Parallax 0.15
planes.P2: Mid ground. Buildings, tree lines, readable shapes. Parallax 0.35
planes.P3: Subject plane. Characters and story-critical objects. Parallax 1.0
planes.P4: Near foreground. Always cropped by the frame edge. Parallax 1.8
planes.note: P4 cropping is what sells the depth. Every exterior scene needs a P4 element.

format.safeArea: Keep all type inside 90% centred box. Shorts crop takes the centre 56.25% of the 16:9 width — compose subjects centrally so verticals derive cleanly.
